Shared low-level scalar storage reads feed both raw value and public bundle getters, retaining mapped buffer identity, mismatch length reset, sticky status and raw alias behavior. Borrowed table/array views update the same concrete holder. Alias/fallback resolution belongs to bundle result initialization, not raw value storage.

The unchanged ICU78.3 uresbund.cpp public witness passes19888 queries: all982 direct package opens, all996 raw alias occurrences from root/keyTypeData, default/parent/root/direct and fill-in open modes, sticky failures, valid/actual identities, complete content digests, every initialized inline/path byte, long heap paths and the63-byte threshold, source alias-depth boundaries, scalar/iterator/copy state, same-handle/fill-in reuse and retained parent/pool references, plus756 actual ResourceDataValue data/valid-locale context cases. Source-valid narrow/count ranges and the pinned immutable default package are the certified projection; physical allocator/OOM/ABI/freed-pointer states and other packages remain uncertified.

ResourceDataValue now also keeps the original borrowed ResourceData and validLocaleDataEntry context with source set/get APIs. Internal ures_getValueWithFallback attaches those exact fields through the caller-owned temporary; empty paths update only the value and sticky failures preserve all prior value fields. The actual likely-subtag loader now follows this source API and retains one StackUResourceBundle for the whole load, closed in finally.
